name: Crystal Calamity
storyline:
You play as the leader of an adventurer squad, but after a fateful mission and a sinister conspiracy, you are framed for the murder of a high-ranking official. Stripped of your powers and with your team destroyed, you find yourself at rock bottom.
In this moment of despair, a spirit from another world saves you. With the power of the Leviathan Crystal, you gain the ability to traverse time and space. To reclaim your strength, rescue your companions, and perhaps even save the world, you must journey to the royal capital and uncover the thousand-year-old secrets hidden within the Leviathan Crystal.
The road ahead is perilous. But with another chance, can you change fate itself?
summary: Crystal Calamity is a roguelike deck-building tactics game where you wield card-based powers and protect spirits from another realm—your living draw and discard piles. Build your deck, fight alongside spirits, and save the world in a land ruled by crystals and cards.
